$description: Endfield-flavoured UI tokens. Platform-neutral source of truth: endfield.css, the Flutter example and the platform guides all follow these values. Colours are sRGB hex; sizes are in logical pixels (CSS px = iOS pt = Android dp = Flutter logical px; on WeChat mini programs multiply by 2 for rpx at the 750rpx design width).

ink.$description: text and every line that matters

chip.$description: quiet fills: idle buttons, chips, tracks

signal.$description: THE accent: here / act on this / look at this. Fill only; never a line or text on light

trace.$description: a line that means 'here' (= ink on light)
= signal on dark: yellow works as a line here

commandBar.$description: the console's command bar is dark in both themes

hatch.$description: ink opacity of the 45° hatch lines (geometry: size.hatch)

contour.$description: ink opacity of the background contour lines

markLight.$description: signal opacity for a highlighter mark, light theme

ui.$description: Interface: a wide geometric Latin face for labels and figures (Saira, variable wdth 50-125 / wght 100-900) with a plain Chinese sans. On native apps the Chinese side may be the system CJK sans (Noto Sans CJK on Android, PingFang on iOS).

text.$description: Reading: the same Chinese sans, regular weight, generous leading.

display.$description: wordmark: scales with the screen, CSS clamp(3rem, 10vw, 11rem); the hollow second line is 0.48 of it

eyebrow.$description: wide upper-case label; letterSpacing in em

measure.$description: a reading line, about 38 Chinese characters

small.$description: tags, chips, current nav item: bottom-right corner

panel.$description: corner a dashboard panel loses towards the centre

hatch.$description: 45° lines rising to the right (/). line = stroke width; period = line + gap, measured across the lines (CSS: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, transparent 0 5px, ink22% 5px 6.5px)). Painters that step along x use stepX = period × √2.

touch.$description: minimum hit target per platform (iOS HIG 44pt, Material 48dp, WCAG 2.5.5 44px). Flutter and cross-platform code use 48.

snap.$description: arrives fast, settles: rows stepping in, items appearing

mech.$description: starts slow, stops hard: shutters, wipes, fills, tabs extending

motion.$description: Cubic-bezier control points. Every motion answers an action; nothing loops for decoration; everything switches off when the system asks for reduced motion.
